name: Yerba mate
summary: The drug is marketed for its ability to suppress appetite and burn fat using higher dosages. The drug has a high ratio of caffeine and is reported to have anti-inflammatory properties.

zhOther: 巴拉圭茶, 瑪黛茶, 馬黛, 馬黛茶
summaryZh: 巴拉圭冬青（學名：Ilex paraguariensis），為冬青科冬青屬植物。原產於南美洲的亞熱帶地區，包括阿根廷北部、巴拉圭、烏拉圭、巴西南部及玻利維亞。
